deps.edn.reason: The git floor on test points at a repository that is bundled here as kotoba.test; it becomes a local root so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. :paths and :aliases are unchanged. nbb.edn.reason: The same git floor as deps.edn is resolved through the bundled kotoba.test by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the source paths.
